targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-642a (2026-08-29, diagnostic, claim-free) did NOT test whether z_block rises under blocked agency. Its C1 statistic is a difference of z_block_PEAK, and z_block_peak saturated at its hard cap (z_block_cap=1.5, ree_core/affect/blocked_agency.py:114) in BOTH the BLOCK and CONTROL arms on all 3 seeds, making the C1 numerator 0.0 by construction; C2 inherits that zero and additionally compares against z_harm_a, which is a constant 0.0 in both arms by design (num_hazards=0). The C0 readiness gate that V3-EXQ-642's autopsy required DID pass (margins 0.62/0.53/0.51 vs 0.10), so the encoder/comparator fix worked. Root cause of the saturation: blocked_agency outcome_mismatch_floor=0.1 sits below the trained model's free-step mismatch baseline (~0.38-0.50), so the integrator accumulates on ordinary prediction error every free step. The recorded z_block_MEAN does separate in the predicted direction on 3/3 seeds (+0.165/+0.121/+0.083) under saturation, i.e. a lower bound on a real effect. The self-routed label 'z_block_integrator_no_rise' is incorrect -- the integrator rises maximally in both arms; it has no headroom. MECH-353's v3_pending gate is NOT cleared and NOT contradicted.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: Calibrate blocked-agency outcome_mismatch_floor against the achievable free-step mismatch baseline
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: outcome_mismatch_floor is a fixed absolute (0.1) compared against a raw normalised mismatch whose free-step baseline is model-dependent and currently ~0.38-0.50, so z_block accumulates on ordinary world-model error and pins at z_block_cap in every condition. Make the attribution threshold relative to a running free-step mismatch baseline (or standardise the mismatch before thresholding) so the floor selects genuinely blocked steps. Until then no blocked-agency DV has dynamic range.

failure_record_entry.target: a working calibration must leave CONTROL-arm z_block well below cap so a BLOCK-vs-CONTROL peak difference >= C1_MARGIN (0.2) is expressible

arguments_withdrawn.argument: The SD-070 P0a warmup was vacuous: its grounding-head holdout reports balanced_accuracy 1.0 with chance 1.0, lift 0.0, n_classes_scored 1, on single-class labels (hazard_present [1.0, 0.0]).
arguments_withdrawn.withdrawn_because: The driver docstring anticipates this explicitly: on a num_hazards=num_resources=0 warmup env the grounding heads 'degrade gracefully to a trivial single-class fit ... without corrupting the reconstruction/anti-collapse terms, which do not depend on either entity type.' The functional test is the C0 readiness gate, which passed on all 3 seeds.

arguments_withdrawn.argument: z_goal_stream.writer_defect: true means this run's z_goal was dead, so every z_goal consumer silently no-opped.
arguments_withdrawn.withdrawn_because: FALSE POSITIVE for this run. The driver deliberately pins a constant goal (lines 225-227 assign agent.goal_state._z_goal directly) because goal-value is a held-constant control in this design; active_frac is 1.0 and goal_state_present is true. writer_calls==0 is the CORRECT behaviour here, not an omission. Reported to the detector owners as a distinct finding below.

learning_extracted: A readiness gate on the COMPARATOR does not license conclusions about the CONSUMER of that comparator. C0 verified that blocked and free steps are distinguishable (margin 0.62); the z_block integrator still could not use that distinction because its own attribution floor sits below both conditions' mismatch. Future readiness gates should be placed on the statistic the load-bearing criterion actually consumes.

A criterion built on a PEAK of a hard-clamped integrator is degenerate whenever the integrator can reach its clamp. z_block_cap=1.5 is reached in both arms; the difference-of-peaks is then 0.0 regardless of behaviour. Prefer a DV with headroom (mean, time-to-threshold, area under the accumulation curve) or record the saturation fraction alongside the peak.

The manifest's degeneracy net did not fire on this run even though the load-bearing DV was fully saturated in both arms. A ceiling rail keyed to z_block_cap on the z_block_peak metric would have caught it.

The z_goal writer_defect detector cannot distinguish a driver that omitted update_z_goal from one that deliberately pins a constant z_goal as an experimental control. Both give writer_calls==0 with goal_state_present true.
